messages:
Olivia: Low-key idea for next Thurs 6:30pm 1: Fondue + flash fiction readings on the rooftop? Small pots, lots of bread/veggies, 2-min story slots. Who's in? :sparkles:
Marcus: In. I have a travel fondue set and a vegan cheese option I can bring.
Hannah: Love this. Ill bring bread + gluten-free crackers. Also happy to MC the readings.
Sven: Yes / 1 / can bring chocolate fondue dippers + marshmallows (for dessert).
Rosa: Maybe / 2 / one guest is dairy-free  will label and bring fruit.
Olivia: RSVP format to keep it tidy: `Yes/Maybe/No + headcount + food contrib + dietary notes`
Marcus: Yes / 1 / travel fondue + vegan cheese / none.
Hannah: Yes / 1 / bread + GF crackers / gluten-free.
Sven: Yes / 1 / dessert dippers / none.
Olivia: Also would anyone like to read a 2-min piece? Sign up in-thread. I'll cap at 8 readers so we have time.
Rosa: Maybe / 2 / will read a short piece if my partner comes.
calendar-bot: Event created 1 "Fondue & Flash Fiction" 1 Thu 2025-03-20 18:30 1 Location: Rooftop (alt: Quiet Lounge). RSVP in thread.
Olivia: Logistics: volunteers for setup (15m) and cleanup (20m)? We need power strip(s) for electric fondue pots and a small table for readings.
Marcus: I can do setup  bring an extension cord and heat mats.
Hannah: I'll handle cleanup. Also I have a battery mic for readings in case wind picks up.
Sven: Quick note: facilities rules on open flames and glassware?
facilities: Please use electric fondue pots only (no open flame) and unbreakable containers on rooftop. Keep volume low after 9pm. Thanks!
Olivia: Great  I'll post a quick weather fallback poll tomorrow AM (Rooftop vs Lounge). Anyone want to host a 5-min improv prompt between readings?
Marcus: Ill do the improv prompt  fun icebreaker.
Hannah: I'll make a tiny sign-up sheet for readers and a timer (2-min per slot).
Rosa: :heart: sounds lovely. See you all then!
